We need to apply the template from make_5_lvl2-template_search-1 to the given molecule. The input includes mapped_rxn and template_id 29646. We need to return all possible precursors (list of lists of SMILES). So we need to apply the template to the target molecule (initial_molecule). Use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles and template_id.

Let's call apply_template.
